parent.original_f112_defect: The F112 diagnostic called wing_case with instance=0. Its chosen=(seed+cohort)%4 equaled query_depth=(seed+cohort)%4 in every diagnostic case. Thus query depth alone revealed the target tag and confounded F112's claims.
parent.f112_Wingless_actual_prior_score: learned, fixed metric, full source-ID table, legacy-offset each 144/144; 64-weight query-only 36/144; this is retrospective public development and NOT learned generalization superiority
parent.f112_Yggdrasil_prior_score: strict and soft binder each 144/144; no net improvement; not under test in F113

scientific_question: When F112's query-depth/target-tag correlation is broken by a frozen full-factorial public cohort, can the previously fitted six-weight engineered similarity mechanism select the correct source's single observation, and is it better than identical-feature untrained or exact-symbolic controls?

intervention.name: F113-orthogonal-source-binding
intervention.train_source: Reuse unchanged F112 96 public TRAIN cases from 68100..68131 with three instances each, 100 fixed update steps; freeze fitted weights once. Do not train on any new F113 cohort.
intervention.frozen_model: F112 LearnedRelationAttention six engineered lexical similarities; no architecture/gradient/parameter change
intervention.no_retraining: No F113 model update or choice of architecture after seeing results, and no old F112 diagnostic outcome used to modify test
control_models: F112 full metadata exact source-code lookup, one observed sign read
F112 trained 64-parameter query-only attention using original F112 TRAIN, one sign read
F112 originally trained F109 64-param modular-offset selector, canonical offset zero, one sign read
intervention.per_block_full_factorial: For local_offset=seed-low in 0..47: q=local_offset%4, chosen_source_tag=((local_offset//4)+block_index)%4; every (query_depth,chosen_tag) cell appears EXACTLY 3 times per block; neither selected tag nor source-ID-code identity is a function of query depth.
intervention.observation_order: Independent seeded random permutation of the four source tags, applied to public source values, with source tag labels available only as ordinary public metadata. Independently seeded distractor sign values.
intervention.public_interface: requested_code, source_codes_by_tag, observation_depths, query_depth and one actual sign read. Query depth is NOT the requested tag; model cannot observe chosen_tag or gold paired outcome.
intervention.counterfactual: For each 48 blocks, positive/negative differ in exactly ONE observation value at the true target/source tag; signs +1 and -1. Full metadata symbolic lookup must score 48/48. The shortcut must score exactly 12/48 by factorial construction.
intervention.strict_disjoint: F113 seed graph/source names and seeds disjoint from all F112 training and diagnostics, and three F113 blocks disjoint from each other. F112 training reused without modification. No protected first-use cases.
intervention.paired_records: Store every per-case seed, q, true-tag only in offline output, source-code commitment, permitted actual one-read selection, and all model/control paired outcomes; labels and graph identities never used inside prediction.
intervention.reproduce: Execute identical frozen code and seeds on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu + Windows; archive per-platform source/report SHA256

evaluation.valid_cohort_if: Each 48 block full 4x4 factorial exactly 3/cell; 48 counterfactual pairs; exact metadata lookup 48; shortcut control 12. If any falsification invariant fails: PROTOCOL_INVALID, no scientific conclusion.
evaluation.source_binding_screen_if: Unchanged learned feature model >=36/48 correct in EACH of three blocks AND >=2/3 correct within every chosen source tag in each block; a positive source-binding screen is limited to PUBLIC synthetic engineering only.
evaluation.incremental_learning_screen_if: Against identically-featured fixed/untrained similarity: >=18 pooled candidate-only minus fixed-only paired wins AND no block negative; otherwise NO_GAIN_OVER_FIXED_METRIC. No superiority claim over perfect full-metadata lookup.
evaluation.result_conventions: If source_binding_screen fails, report negative; if passes and incremental-learning fails, report source binding without learned superiority. Query shortcut negative is required. No threshold retuning.
